verdict.rationale: The Gemini API's core interaction model is natural-language prompting, with function calling letting the model interpret NL instructions and decide when to invoke external tools/actions, plus Live API for real-time voice/vision NL interaction and an Interactions API exposing reasoning steps alongside function calls and agent actions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of natural-language command reliability and no dedicated conversational CLI/agent shell demonstrating end-to-end NL-driven operation beyond docs.
